notes:
My Blocks lets you keep your original blocks and use them in another quilt.

- Select a custom block and choose **Save to My Blocks**. Open it later from **Library → My Blocks…** or the visible **My Blocks** button.
- Browse saved thumbnails, search by name, and use a block throughout a quilt or replace the selected block.
- Saved blocks retain exact geometry, finished size, colors, fabric photos, orientation and tracing guides. Each quilt receives its own copy.
- Rename, edit saved drawings and remove library entries without changing older quilt projects.
- My Blocks stays on your computer with a previous-version backup. Quilt Undo reverses inserting a saved block.

This is the focused personal-block-library milestone. Additional layout types, layers/appliqué and other personal asset libraries remain future work. Only complete custom blocks can be saved; the library supports up to 100 entries within 100 MB.

To update: save your work, choose **Help → Check for Updates**, select **Preview / Development**, then **Check for updates → Download & install**. After restart, choose **Restore design** to resume your quilt. Copies without the update button can install this Setup over the existing version.
